classes.name: InputConfigManager
classes.comment: Function-local static at 0x1e455c, guard dword 0x1e458c bit 0 (directly after the object, proving 0x30). Get 0x50270 inlines the PS2 constructor (PS2 0x166508) and registers no atexit. PS2 stores initialised/inverted as ints; Xbox writes and reads them as bytes.

fields.name: initialised
fields.evidence: Get 0x50287 MOV byte [0x1e455c],0; InitAndPreload 0x5067a MOV byte [EDI],1; Shutdown 0x50131 MOV byte [ECX],BL(0). No Xbox reader in scope. PS2 +0x0 int.

fields.name: currentConfigType
fields.evidence: InputConfigManager::ConfigType (PS2 name): 0 Driving, 1 POV; Get stores 2 (GetCurrentConfig's 'current' sentinel). SetConfig 0x50730 stores arg1; InitAndPreload 0x5067d stores 0; GetCurrentConfig 0x50189 reads it when arg==2; RPlayerCamera::CameraInputCallback 0x81848 compares it with 1.

fields.name: currentConfig
fields.evidence: Index into configInfos[type]. InitAndPreload loads [0]=[0x2445a4], [1]=[0x24451c] and resets >= numConfigs to 0; SetConfig 0x50735 stores arg2 unless it is -1; GetCurrentConfig returns [ECX+EAX*4+8].

fields.name: numConfigs
fields.evidence: ParseMasterConfigFile 0x5036d ('Driving' N) and 0x503f8 ('POV' N), via atol; GetNumConfigs 0x50174 returns [ECX+i*4+0x10]; loop bound in Shutdown and InitAndPreload.

fields.name: configInfos
fields.evidence: operator new[](N*0x5c) 0x114710 in ParseMasterConfigFile (stored 0x503ab/0x50431); operator delete[] 0x1146e0 in Shutdown 0x5011b; GetLocaleID, SetConfig and InitAndPreload index [+0x18+type*4] + idx*0x5c.

fields.name: inverted
fields.evidence: SetInverted 0x50144 MOV [ECX+0x20],AL; IsInverted 0x50160 MOV AL,[ECX+0x20]; InitAndPreload 0x5069a = ([0x2445b4] != 0). Get does not initialise it (bss zero). PS2 +0x20 int.

fields.name: frontEndNameLookup
fields.evidence: InitAndPreload 0x50612 = new StringToNumber(0x1b6f58) (FastAlloc 0x10 'StringToNumber'); used by ParseDefFileForFrontEnd 0x4ffe6; destroyed, FastFree'd (0x10) and zeroed at 0x5065c-0x50677. Get zeroes it (0x1e4580). Name invented.

fields.name: frontEndDefText
fields.evidence: InitAndPreload 0x50520 = UFileLoader::FileLoad("data/Control/FrontEnd.def", 0); parsed first by every mapping load (InitAndPreload 0x506f3, SetConfig 0x50782); FileFree'd by Shutdown 0x500e2. Get zeroes it (0x1e4584). The earlier name 'masterFileData' was wrong: Master.def is parsed and freed at once.

fields.name: unusedFileData
fields.evidence: Only Get (zeroes 0x1e4588) and Shutdown (FileFree if non-NULL, 0x500fd) touch it; nothing in scope writes it (the same on PS2). Name invented.

classes.name: ConfigInfo
classes.comment: PS2 name (ParseDefFileForFrontEnd(ConfigInfo *, char *)). Arrays are allocated with operator new[](N*0x5c), with no cookie and no ctor: ParseMasterConfigFile zeroes fileName[0], defText and the 14 locale ids itself.

fields.name: fileName
fields.evidence: ParseMasterConfigFile 0x50454 copies the token byte by byte (an unbounded strcpy) to record+0; InitAndPreload appends it to "data/Control/" (0x5056e). Byte 0 zeroed at 0x5039c. The size is the distance to +0x20.

fields.name: defText
fields.evidence: InitAndPreload 0x505a5 = FileLoad(path, 0); passed to ParseDefFileForFrontEnd (0x50633) and LoadParseDefFile (0x506d9, 0x50768); Shutdown FileFree's and zeroes it (0x500a5-0x500b9).

fields.name: frontEndLocaleIDs
fields.evidence: Zeroed by REP STOSD with ECX=0xe from +0x24 (0x50395). ParseDefFileForFrontEnd 0x50005 stores atol(value) at +0x24+slot*4. GetLocaleID 0x501ba reads [rec + (idx*0x17+slot)*4 + 0x24]. Slots come from table 0x1b6f58: 0 ButtonA, 1 ButtonB, 2 ButtonY, 3 ButtonX, 4 DPadLeftRight, 5 DPadUpDown, 6 ButtonLThumb, 7 ButtonLTrigger, 8 ButtonBlack, 9 ButtonRThumb, 10 ButtonRTrigger, 11 ButtonWhite, 12 DESCRIPTION, 13 TITLE.

classes.name: StringToNumber
classes.comment: SupportPS2.lib UStringToNum. Built over a caller-owned StringToNumberEntry table ending in string==NULL. A table of 31 or more entries gets two sorted copies in one FastAlloc(count*16, "StringToNumber") block: one sorted by string (0x119ef0, strcmp on .string) and one by number (0x119f40, a.number - b.number). Smaller tables are searched linearly. Instances: 0x1e23e0 (actions, 0x1b6ba0, 117 entries, sorted), 0x1e4590 (update methods, 0x1b6fd0, 10 entries, linear), InputToAction::scalarNameLookup (20 pad scalars, linear), InputConfigManager::frontEndNameLookup (0x1b6f58, 14 entries, linear).

fields.name: count
fields.evidence: ctor 0x119f72 = the number of entries before the first NULL .string; dtor FastFree size count<<4; BinarySearch hi = count-1; bound of the linear search.

fields.name: table
fields.evidence: ctor 0x119f74 = arg; the linear ConvertStringToNumber path 0x11a142.

fields.name: sortedByString
fields.evidence: ctor 0x119f95 = the FastAlloc block, or 0 when count < 31 (0x119ffc); ConvertStringToNumber tests it to choose binary search (0x11a112) and returns [it+idx*8]; BinarySearch reads [+8]+idx*8+4; the dtor frees it.

fields.name: sortedByNumber
fields.evidence: ctor 0x119f90 = block + count*8, sorted with 0x119f40; 0 when count < 31. Nothing in scope reads it (PS2 ConvertNumberToString/BinarySearch(int)).

classes.name: StringToNumberEntry
classes.comment: {number, string}. The table ends at the first entry whose string is NULL; that entry's number is ignored.

fields.name: number
fields.evidence: ConvertStringToNumber returns [entry+0]; InputToAction ctor 0x508f3 stores i.

fields.name: string
fields.evidence: The ctor counts until [entry+4]==0; the comparators and BinarySearch read +4.

classes.name: InputTable
classes.comment: Checked again: ctor 0x507a0, dtor 0x507c0, GrowArrayForOneElement 0x507e0, AddTableEntry inlined in LoadParseDefFile 0x50b31-0x50b6a, Clear inlined in InputToAction::Reset 0x50990.

fields.name: count
fields.evidence: ctor 0; Reset 0x509a3 zeroes it; LoadParseDefFile INC [ESI] 0x50b6a; Grow copies count entries.

fields.name: capacity
fields.evidence: ctor 4; Grow += 4 (0x507eb); LoadParseDefFile grows when count >= capacity (0x50b47); the dtor frees capacity*0xc.

fields.name: entries
fields.evidence: ctor = this+0xc; Grow = FastAlloc(capacity*0xc, "TableEntries"); the dtor frees it if != this+0xc.

fields.name: inlineEntries
fields.evidence: ctor LEA ECX,[EAX+0xc]; 0x3c-0xc = 4*0xc.

fields.name: updateMethod
fields.evidence: LoadParseDefFile 0x50b62 stores the method index (0..9, table 0x1b6fd0); the default is 0.

fields.name: threshold
fields.evidence: 0x50b64: 0.5f (0x3f000000) for methods 3/4, otherwise 0, then overridden by sscanf("%f").

fields.name: action
fields.evidence: 0x50b67: getActionID(first token), which is 0x75 when the name is unknown.

fields.name: numTables
fields.evidence: ctor = device->GetNumDeviceScalar() (vtable slot 3); Reset loop bound.

fields.name: tables
fields.evidence: operator new[](n*0x3c+4) with a count cookie at [-4]; LoadParseDefFile indexes tables + scalarIndex*0x3c.

fields.name: scalarNameLookup
fields.evidence: FastAlloc(0x10, "StringToNumber") + ctor over scalarNames; LoadParseDefFile 0x50abb ConvertStringToNumber(scalar token).

fields.name: scalarNames
fields.evidence: FastAlloc(n*8+8, "StringToNumberEntry"): {i, &device->scalars[i].name} (the inline char[32] at DeviceScalar+4), then {0, NULL}.

notes: InputConfigManager::Get 0x50270 is static and cdecl with no arguments (it clobbers CL). Ghidra shows it as __thiscall; callers do MOV ECX,EAX after it.

Prototypes: ParseMasterConfigFile(char *text) thiscall RET 4; ParseDefFileForFrontEnd(ConfigInfo *info, char *text) thiscall RET 8 (Ghidra currently shows no parameters); SetConfig(ConfigType type, int index) thiscall RET 8 (index -1 = keep); SetInverted(bool) RET 4; GetNumConfigs(ConfigType) RET 4; GetCurrentConfig(ConfigType, 2 = current) RET 4; GetLocaleID(ConfigType type, int configIndex, int slot) RET 0xc.

FUN_00119f40 is StringToNumber's number comparator for qsort (cdecl, returns a->number - b->number). FUN_00119ef0 is the string comparator (strcmp on ->string, inlined). FUN_0011a1b0 is NOT part of StringToNumber: it is a helper of DAFI_open (0x11a240) with a register convention (EAX = cursor, EDX = end). It skips to the first non-blank character of the next line and returns NULL at the end.
0x117110 (Ghidra 'MEM_free') is a JMP thunk to MEM_free 0x113f20; PS2 calls UFileLoader::FileFree at the same places.

The globals 0x2445a4 (Driving config), 0x24451c (POV config), 0x2445b4 (inverted) and 0x244520 (glbIFeedback, the active port) are fields of the UberBond launch page, which is copied to 0x243b90 (uberBondScoreBuffer): offsets 0xa14, 0x98c, 0xa24 and 0x990. The PS2 page base 0x100000 gives the same offsets (DAT_00100a14/0010098c/00100a24/00100990). MissionName 0x244084 = page+0x4f4.
